title: Ship your first grounded API
summary: Turn a familiar endpoint into a system that can find evidence, answer and be tested.

steps.task: Write the user outcome and response contract.
Identify source ownership and allowed use.
Retrieve evidence before you generate.
Label real questions and relevant sources.
Require supported answers and explicit abstention.
Measure a simple baseline before adding complexity.
Observe failures and prepare a rollback.

title: Give an agent tools safely
summary: Connect an interactive agent, constrain its tools and keep people in consequential decisions.

steps.task: Specify the task and what success changes.
Separate the agent loop from its integrations.
Define the workflow and failure states.
Test outputs and the sequence of actions.
Agree how people judge success.
Make decisions and failures inspectable.

title: Decide if a change is better
summary: Ask for evidence you can act on, from representative cases to uncertainty and release decisions.

steps.task: Define the consequence of a wrong answer.
Capture representative and difficult cases.
Protect independent evaluation data.
Agree an observable success rubric.
Calibrate automated judging against people.
Compare paired outcomes with uncertainty.
Choose release and rollback criteria.

title: Adapt and host a model
summary: Compare prompts, weights and hosting choices while protecting a trustworthy evaluation set.

steps.task: Record quality, cost and latency today.
Choose what you want optimization to change.
Keep training and test evidence separate.
Check what generated data cannot tell you.
Plan capacity and operational ownership.
Compare practical gains and service costs.
